text: Dispatch. Welcome to the night shift. You start at the post on P1. Nothing gets you in here.
Rule one: stay where a camera can see you. The floor glows where they look.
Your round is on your clipboard. Do all of it before six.
The P3 generator is out. Take the stairs down. The fuel can is somewhere on P3. Mind the dark corners.
Raise your camcorder with F. Whatever it films is safe.
Dispatch. The lights on P3 have been stuttering.
When they flicker look for the cameras whose red light stays on. Those keep working.
Dispatch. We will lose power tonight.
When it goes get under a red light and stay there. Do not cross the dark.
Dispatch. Someone has been tampering with the camera lines.
If a camera dies the junction box is under it. Splice it.
Dispatch... this is the last round. Finish it before six.
Guard. Are you on camera right now? Stay there. Please stay there.
[static]
note: no dispatcher on the hard night

text: Lights are going. Watch for the red lights.
Power is down. Get under a red light. Now.
A camera line went dead. The box is under the camera.
Three o'clock. Halfway.
Five o'clock. Finish your round.
Guard? ... Guard respond.
That's six. Good work. Go home.
That wasn't me on the radio a minute ago. I wasn't talking.
note: night 4: the radio speaks when it shouldn't (plan section 6)

text: Guard. Stop. Don't go in there. That room is not on any camera.
What did you film? ... Bring the tape up. Bring it up to me.
Camera 07 just blew a fuse. Spares are in the locker at the post.
We lost P4. Everything down there is dark. The breaker panel is in the electrical room.
One of the tapes is missing. Somebody left it out on P3. Bring it back to the VCR.
Guard... there is a wall on P4 that wasn't there yesterday. Take the hammer from the bench.
If a light stutters right above you don't stand under it. Find a red one.
Five o'clock. The blackouts last longer now. Plan your way from camera to camera.
A line went dead. The box is under that camera. Splice it before the next blackout.
Five o'clock. I count more dead cameras than I sent you to fix.
Three o'clock. Guard... I can see you on cam two. Who is that behind you?
[static] ...stay... on... camera...
note: the hard night: the radio only breaks through

text: [static] ...it knows the cameras now...
Mind the stairwell. Down there the cameras are older.
